value.rationale: The exact four-coefficient-degree collapse and matching/triangle reduction solve the entire partition enumerator—not merely the coalition number—for all isolate-free graphs at domination deficiency ≤2. The sharp threshold at N=7 and the triangle criterion give structural distinctions even between graphs with the same single-set domination minimum. The complete multipartite corollary is an infinite explicit family with 4-block existence governed by three non-singleton parts and nontrivial matching-count coefficients. This is a motivated newly introduced invariant and a complete structural classification, not an arbitrary fixed-size table.
